exposure: endotracheal surfactant and budesonide combination therapy
cohort: Newborns diagnosed with Neonatal Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (NARDS) secondary to Late-Onset Neonatal Sepsis (LONS) who received endotracheal surfactant and budesonide combination therapy.
finding: Endotracheal surfactant and budesonide combination therapy significantly decreased the need for inspired oxygen and oxygen saturation index (OSI) while increasing preductal oxygen saturation (SpO2) in neonates with NARDS due to LONS.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between August 2022 and September 2023, with oxygenation status compared before and two hours after treatment.
gest_age: Mean corrected gestational age of 33.3 ± 2.9 weeks at the time of treatment.
